title: NASA Tests a System for Safer Moon Landings
paragraphs: NASA tested a new landing system. It is called SPLICE. It helps a spacecraft land safely.
The test was on 27 August 2026. It was in California. A small drone flew with the system. The drone has four rotors.
SPLICE looks at the ground. It makes a map. It finds rocks and holes. If the place is not safe, it moves the drone to a better place.

questions.q: What does SPLICE do if a place is not safe?
questions.a: It moves the drone to a better place.
